svg.metadata: {"attribution":"Technology Commons teaching materials by Andrew Andrade and contributors","category":"calibration","description":"A 100 mm square, diagonal and 50 mm circle for checking exported physical scale.","dimensional_tests":{"circle_diameter_mm":50,"square_height_mm":100,"square_width_mm":100},"dimensions":{"height":150,"width":220},"editors":["Inkscape","Vectorpea"],"files":{"preview":"generated/previews/calibration/tc-cal-dimension-verification.svg","svg":"generated/svg/calibration/tc-cal-dimension-verification.svg"},"fit_type":"none","generator":{"name":"technology-commons-laser-generator","version":"0.1.0"},"id":"tc-cal-dimension-verification","kerf_assumptions":{"clearance_mm":0.15,"kerf_mm":0.15,"warning":"Starting values only; select from a physical calibration cut."},"license":"CC-BY-SA-4.0","material":{"measured_thickness_mm":6.0,"name":"Baltic birch plywood","nominal":"1/4 inch","warning":"Measure every sheet; nominal 1/4 inch plywood is not necessarily 6.35 mm."},"notes":"Verify dimensions and local machine operation mapping before fabrication.","operations":["CUT","SCORE","ENGRAVE"],"parameters":{},"review_status":"unverified","sensitivity":"none","shop":"general","skill_level":"introductory","source_reference":"Original procedural geometry; no traced or copied commercial artwork.","subcategory":"dimensions","tags":["calibration","circle","dimension","ruler","square"],"title":"Dimension verification sheet","tool_family":"none","trademark_status":"original-generic","units":"mm"}
